stem: In 2013-14, India's exports were worth Rs 19,05,011 crore and its imports Rs 27,15,434 crore. What was India's trade balance that year?

stem: A student argues that because manufactured goods fell from 72.9 per cent of exports in 2015-16 to 67.8 per cent in 2021-22, the value of manufactured exports must have fallen. Evaluate the claim.
options: Correct, since a falling share must always mean a falling value
Incorrect; a smaller share of a bigger total can mean more value
Correct, since the total value of exports also fell in this period
Incorrect, since the share of manufactured goods in fact rose
